```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
source("_data.R")
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(plotly)
library(knitr)

# Chronological week order: regular season 1-18, then playoffs
week_levels <- c(as.character(1:18), "WC", "Div", "Conf", "SB")

scored_weeks <- unique(weekly_summary$week)
scored_weeks <- scored_weeks[order(match(scored_weeks, week_levels))]
has_data     <- length(scored_weeks) > 0

# --- Colors -------------------------------------------------------------
# Assigned in fixed order by position in the Users tab, so a person keeps
# their color as the standings move. Participants 9+ reuse the colors with a dashed line.
pal        <- c("skyblue", "purple", "lightgreen", "darkorange",
                "hotpink", "darkgreen", "darkblue", "red")
user_color <- setNames(pal[(seq_along(all_users) - 1) %% 8 + 1], all_users)
user_dash  <- setNames(ifelse(seq_along(all_users) <= 8, "solid", "dash"), all_users)

ink      <- "#52514e"   # secondary text
grid_col <- "#e6e5e1"   # recessive grid
surface  <- "#fcfcfb"   # used for the 2px gaps between stacked bars

# --- Weekly data: one row per participant per scored week -------------------
if (has_data) {
  trend <- weekly_summary %>%
    select(user, week, week_dollars, correct, picks = total) %>%
    tidyr::complete(user = all_users, week = scored_weeks,
                    fill = list(week_dollars = 0, correct = 0, picks = 0)) %>%
    mutate(week = factor(week, levels = scored_weeks)) %>%
    arrange(user, week) %>%
    group_by(user) %>%
    mutate(
      total       = cumsum(week_dollars),
      cum_correct = cumsum(correct),
      cum_picks   = cumsum(picks),
      win_pct     = ifelse(cum_picks > 0, 100 * cum_correct / cum_picks, NA_real_)
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(week = as.character(week))

  # Current standings order (leader first), used to sort rows in the charts below
  leader_order <- trend %>%
    group_by(user) %>%
    summarise(t = sum(week_dollars), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(desc(t)) %>%
    pull(user)
}

# Adds one line per participant to a plotly object
add_user_lines <- function(p, data, xcol, ycol, fmt, suffix = "") {
  for (u in all_users) {
    d <- data[data$user == u, ]
    p <- add_trace(
      p, x = d[[xcol]], y = d[[ycol]],
      type = "scatter", mode = "lines+markers", name = u, connectgaps = TRUE,
      line   = list(color = user_color[[u]], width = 2, dash = user_dash[[u]]),
      marker = list(color = user_color[[u]], size = 8,
                    line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
      hovertemplate = paste0("%{y:", fmt, "}", suffix, "<extra>", u, "</extra>")
    )
  }
  p
}
```

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| results: asis
if (!has_data) cat("_No scored games yet — the charts will appear once the first results are entered._")
```

## Money Over Time

Running dollar total for every participant, week by week. Hover for exact amounts, click a name in the legend to hide or show a line, and double-click a name to isolate it.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {

  x_levels <- c("Start", scored_weeks)

  # Everyone starts the season at $0
  line_data <- trend %>%
    select(user, week, total) %>%
    bind_rows(tibble(user = all_users, week = "Start", total = 0)) %>%
    arrange(user, match(week, x_levels))

  plot_ly() %>%
    add_user_lines(line_data, "week", "total", "$,.0f") %>%
    layout(
      hovermode = "x unified",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font   = list(color = ink),
      xaxis  = list(title = "Week", type = "category",
                    categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = x_levels,
                    showgrid = FALSE, linecolor = grid_col, tickcolor = grid_col),
      yaxis  = list(title = "", tickprefix = "$", tickformat = ",.0f",
                    gridcolor = grid_col, zeroline = TRUE,
                    zerolinecolor = "#9b9a94", zerolinewidth = 1),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
      margin = list(t = 10, r = 20)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

}
```


## Weekly Results

Each cell is one person's dollar result for one week. Green means they made money, red means they lost money, and gray means they broke even. Participants are sorted with the current leader on top. Hover for the exact amount.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {

  hm <- trend %>%
    select(user, week, week_dollars) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from = week, values_from = week_dollars)

  z <- as.matrix(hm[match(leader_order, hm$user), scored_weeks])
  m <- max(abs(z), na.rm = TRUE)
  if (!is.finite(m) || m == 0) m <- 1

  plot_ly(
    x = scored_weeks, y = leader_order, z = z, type = "heatmap",
    zmin = -m, zmax = m,
    # red <-> green poles with a neutral gray midpoint at $0
    colorscale = list(c(0, "red"), c(0.5, "#f0efec"), c(1, "darkgreen")),
    xgap = 2, ygap = 2,
    colorbar = list(title = "", tickprefix = "$", tickformat = ",.0f",
                    thickness = 12, len = 0.9),
    hovertemplate = "%{y} · Week %{x}<br>%{z:$,.0f}<extra></extra>",
    height = 90 + 38 * length(all_users)
  ) %>%
    layout(
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font  = list(color = ink),
      xaxis = list(title = "Week", type = "category",
                   categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = scored_weeks,
                   showgrid = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "", type = "category",
                   categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(leader_order),
                   showgrid = FALSE),
      margin = list(t = 10, r = 20)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

}
```

## Where the Money Comes From

Each person's season total split into base picks, bonus picks, and missed-pick penalties. The diamond marks the net total, so you can see who is making money on bonus picks and who is losing it.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {

  src <- standings %>%
    mutate(user = factor(user, levels = rev(leader_order))) %>%
    arrange(user)

  gap <- list(color = surface, width = 2)   # 2px gap between stacked segments

  plot_ly(src, y = ~user, orientation = "h", height = 90 + 38 * length(all_users)) %>%
    add_bars(x = ~base_dollars,   name = "Base picks",
             marker = list(color = pal[1], line = gap),
             hovertemplate = "%{x:$,.0f}<extra>Base picks</extra>") %>%
    add_bars(x = ~bonus_dollars,  name = "Bonus picks",
             marker = list(color = pal[2], line = gap),
             hovertemplate = "%{x:$,.0f}<extra>Bonus picks</extra>") %>%
    add_bars(x = ~missed_dollars, name = "Missed picks",
             marker = list(color = pal[3], line = gap),
             hovertemplate = "%{x:$,.0f}<extra>Missed picks</extra>") %>%
    add_markers(x = ~total_dollars, name = "Net total",
                marker = list(symbol = "diamond", size = 11, color = "#0b0b0b",
                              line = list(color = "#ffffff", width = 2)),
                hovertemplate = "%{x:$,.0f}<extra>Net total</extra>") %>%
    layout(
      barmode = "relative", bargap = 0.45,
      hovermode = "y unified",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font  = list(color = ink),
      xaxis = list(title = "", tickprefix = "$", tickformat = ",.0f",
                   gridcolor = grid_col, zeroline = TRUE,
                   zerolinecolor = "#9b9a94", zerolinewidth = 1),
      yaxis = list(title = "", type = "category",
                   categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = rev(leader_order),
                   showgrid = FALSE),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.15),
      margin = list(t = 10, r = 20)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

}
```

## Win Percentage Over Time

Each person's cumulative win rate across the picks they actually made, with pushes counted as wins. This leaves out the dollar swings from bonus picks, so it shows who is picking well rather than who got lucky with a bonus. The dotted line is 50%, the break-even point against the spread. Early in the season these lines swing a lot because there are few picks behind them.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {

  plot_ly() %>%
    add_user_lines(trend, "week", "win_pct", ".1f", suffix = "%") %>%
    layout(
      hovermode = "x unified",
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font   = list(color = ink),
      xaxis  = list(title = "Week", type = "category",
                    categoryorder = "array", categoryarray = scored_weeks,
                    showgrid = FALSE, linecolor = grid_col, tickcolor = grid_col),
      yaxis  = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "%", tickformat = ".0f",
                    gridcolor = grid_col, zeroline = FALSE),
      shapes = list(list(type = "line", xref = "paper", x0 = 0, x1 = 1,
                         yref = "y", y0 = 50, y1 = 50,
                         line = list(color = "#9b9a94", width = 1, dash = "dot"))),
      legend = list(orientation = "h", y = -0.2),
      margin = list(t = 10, r = 20)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

}
```

## Win Probability

(This is a work in progress. Do not read into it much.)

The chance each person finishes the season with the most money, from simulating the rest of the season 10,000 times. Hover for each person's current total and expected final total.

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false

if (has_data) {

  # --- Settings you can change ---------------------------------------------
  N_SIMS      <- 10000        # number of simulated seasons
  TOTAL_GAMES <- 285          # 272 regular-season games + 13 playoff games
  PRIOR_PICKS <- 0          # how hard to pull everyone's record toward 50% (bigger = more skeptical). 200, for example?
  set.seed(2026)              # keeps the percentages from jumping around on every render

  # --- Step 1: how many games are left? --------------------------------------
  games_scored <- sum(!is.na(games$correct_pick))
  games_left   <- max(TOTAL_GAMES - games_scored, 0)

  # --- Step 2: estimate three habits for each person -------------------------
  #   p = chance a pick is right   (record so far, pulled strongly toward 50%)
  #   q = chance they make a pick on a given game (the rest cost $25 each)
  #   b = share of their picks they flag as bonus
  bonus_counts <- results %>%
    filter(!is.na(correct)) %>%
    group_by(user) %>%
    summarise(bonus_picks = sum(bonus, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop")

  model <- standings %>%
    select(user, correct, total, total_dollars) %>%
    left_join(bonus_counts, by = "user") %>%
    mutate(
      bonus_picks = coalesce(bonus_picks, 0),
      p = (correct + PRIOR_PICKS * 0.5) / (total + PRIOR_PICKS),
      q = if (games_scored > 0) pmin(total / games_scored, 1) else 1,
      b = ifelse(total > 0, bonus_picks / total, 0)
    )

  # --- Step 3: simulate the rest of the season for one person ----------------
  # Returns their final dollar total in each of the N_SIMS simulated seasons.
  simulate_player <- function(p, q, b, current) {
    made   <- rbinom(N_SIMS, games_left, q)     # games they pick
    n_b    <- rbinom(N_SIMS, made, b)           # of those, bonus picks
    wins_b <- rbinom(N_SIMS, n_b, p)            # bonus picks won
    wins_n <- rbinom(N_SIMS, made - n_b, p)     # normal picks won
    base   <- 100 * (2 * (wins_b + wins_n) - made)
    bonus  <- 200 * (2 * wins_b - n_b)
    missed <- -25 * (games_left - made)
    current + base + bonus + missed
  }

  # One column per person, one row per simulated season
  final <- sapply(seq_len(nrow(model)), function(i) {
    simulate_player(model$p[i], model$q[i], model$b[i], model$total_dollars[i])
  })

  # --- Step 4: who finished first in each simulation? (ties broken at random) -
  winner   <- max.col(final, ties.method = "random")
  win_prob <- 100 * tabulate(winner, nbins = nrow(model)) / N_SIMS

  fmt_money <- function(x) paste0(ifelse(x < 0, "-$", "$"), format(abs(round(x)), big.mark = ","))

  prob <- model %>%
    mutate(win_prob = win_prob, expected = colMeans(final)) %>%
    arrange(desc(win_prob))

  plot_ly(
    prob,
    y = ~factor(user, levels = rev(user)), x = ~win_prob,
    type = "bar", orientation = "h",
    marker = list(color = pal[1]),
    text = ~paste0(round(win_prob, 1), "%"), textposition = "outside", cliponaxis = FALSE,
    hoverinfo = "text",
    hovertext = ~paste0(user, "<br>Chance to win: ", round(win_prob, 1), "%",
                        "<br>Current total: ", fmt_money(total_dollars),
                        "<br>Expected final total: ", fmt_money(expected)),
    height = 90 + 38 * length(all_users)
  ) %>%
    layout(
      bargap = 0.45,
      paper_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)", plot_bgcolor = "rgba(0,0,0,0)",
      font  = list(color = ink),
      xaxis = list(title = "", ticksuffix = "%", tickformat = ".0f",
                   range = c(0, max(prob$win_prob) * 1.2 + 2),
                   gridcolor = grid_col, zeroline = FALSE),
      yaxis = list(title = "", type = "category", showgrid = FALSE),
      margin = list(t = 10, r = 40)
    ) %>%
    config(displayModeBar = FALSE)

}
```
